# The SR Pictures
> The SR Pictures is a premier photography and cinematography studio based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Specializing in luxury wedding films, showroom car delivery shoots, resort promotional cinematography, and 4K aerial drone coverage.

## Studio Overview
- **Name**: The SR Pictures
- **Location**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (560001)
- **Primary Specializations**: Weddings, Car Delivery Shoots, Resort Films, Drone Cinematography
- **Primary Website**: https://photoportfolio-lake.vercel.app/
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 96322 08050
- **Email**: thesrpictures17@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Sunday, 09:00 AM – 09:00 PM IST
- **Geographic Coverage**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, Mysore, Coorg, Chikmagalur, Kabini, Ooty, Goa, Kerala, and Worldwide Destination Weddings.

## Core Services & Offerings
- **Wedding Cinematography & Candid Photography**: Multi-angle Sony FX cinema rigs, natural aesthetic color grading, 4K highlights, master wedding films, and archival flush-mount lay-flat albums.
- **Car Delivery Shoots**: Professional cinematic documentation of new vehicle deliveries at automotive showrooms. Covers unveiling, key handover, family celebrations, rolling shots, and 60-second 4K Instagram reels. Starting at ₹14,999.
- **Resort & Hospitality Films**: Luxury architectural walkthroughs, guest experience storytelling, aesthetic interior showcases, and dramatic drone landscape perspectives for resorts and villas.
- **4K Drone Cinematography**: High dynamic range 4K 60fps aerial capture adhering to DGCA regulations. Available as a +₹8,000 upgrade or included in premium collections.
